summary.description: Short official description of the venue from the site. Null if none. Do not invent.

address.description: Street address as printed. Null if not on the site.

area.description: Neighbourhood or area name if printed, e.g. Playa d'en Bossa.

phone.description: Phone number exactly as printed. Null if missing.

email.description: Public email if printed. Null if missing.

hours.description: Opening hours or door times as printed. Null if missing. Do not invent.

season.description: Season or opening period if printed.

doorPolicy.description: Door, ID or guest-list policy if printed.

music.description: Music style or residencies if printed.

vipHow.description: How to request VIP/tables according to the official site. No invented prices.

gettingThere.description: How to get there if printed (taxi, bus, boat).

highlights.description: Short official facts from the page only.
